text:
Samira Patel: Nimbus sent a marketplace partnership term sheet. Key asks: co-branded listing, hosted API + optional quantized bundles for SIs, and a 70/30 rev share (Redwood 70). Need decision by next Wed.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Do we have their proposed license? Hosted vs redistribute changes legal scope dramatically.
Samira Patel: They attached a draft but it's vague on redistribution rights; says "partner distribution permitted" without license file.
Evelyn Chu: Engineering: if they permit quantized bundles we need artifact signing, eval suite, and a quantization acceptance gate. Otherwise hosted-only is simpler.
Lina Gomez: PM/marketing: we need SKU mapping (hosted, reserved capacity, private bundle) and co-branding assets. Request Nimbus agree to a single SKU taxonomy.
Marcus Liu: Sales wants per-SKU economics, not a flat split. Propose negotiating hosted 70/30, dedicated 60/40, private bundles 50/50.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Legal checklist: require license text (no NC/ND), export-control review for downloadable weights, indemnity terms, trademark usage, and explicit prohibition on using customer data to train their models.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: fill partnership-docs template v1.3 at https://redwood.internal/partner-templates.
Evelyn Chu: Technical checklist:
```
- artifact formats (gguf/pt)
- allowed quant profiles
- runtime compat matrix
- perf samples (latency/cost)
- signed hashes for provenance
- eval dataset + regression thresholds
```
Samira Patel: Action items: Nimbus to provide license file, asset pack, and SKU list. Internal: legal to validate license, eng to draft quant gate, product to propose SKU taxonomy, sales to draft commercial counter. Deadline: internal feedback by Tue 17:00 PT so we can reply Wed.
Lina Gomez: Marketing requests 2-week embargo for joint PR and single Nimbus creative contact.
Marcus Liu: I'll draft a counter with per-SKU splits and a 90-day performance review/clawback.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: If redistribution is blocked, propose hosted-only listing + co-marketing badge.
Samira Patel: Thanks all — updating when Nimbus replies. :handshake:
